'''Bettle's sister''' was the sister of [[Bettle]], and one of two daughters of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] resistance leader [[Jerell]]. She died as a result of the actions of [[Dennix Graeber]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Ralltiir. Jerell continued to loathe Graeber for her loss as late as the liberation of Ralltiir by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="H&R" />
